condition_other: insomnia symptoms (PSQI 6-10, no formal clinical diagnosis)
readout_other: overnight polysomnography (EEG/EOG/EMG) sleep staging; rsBOLD, ALFF and resting-state connectivity; ASL cerebral blood flow; heart rate variability; Hariri emotional face-matching fMRI task; SSS, ESS, STAI-S
direction_notes: STN-FUS night versus sham night was associated with longer REM duration and shorter REM latency, with no overall change in other sleep stages; fMRI after stimulation showed increased left-STN BOLD variability and left NAc CBF, which the authors interpret as probable STN inhibition without being able to separate excitatory from inhibitory input.
safety_notes: SpO2, heart rate and blood pressure were monitored during stimulation with no significant changes, surface temperature and ex vivo skull heating were checked, and participants were followed up by email one week later; no adverse events are described.

exposures.label: Left STN-FUS with NEUSLeeP wearable concentric ring array (100 Hz PRF)

device.model: custom 8-channel Concentric Ring Ultrasound Transducer Array (CRUTA) in NEUSLeeP patch, driven by Verasonics Vantage 64LE HIFU

timing.protocol_description: Pulse Repetition Frequency 100 Hz, pulse duration 0.5 ms, duty cycle 5%, 30 s ON 30 s OFF. In the fMRI session 10 blocks (10 min); in the sleep study 5 min blocks delivered every 90 minutes for a total of five blocks overnight.

source_quotes.n_subjects: a total of 28 subjects across both groups’ (healthy, n = 16; 8 males and 8 females / insomnia, n = 12; 6 males and 6 females
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: On the second night with the FUS session, FUS was delivered with the ultrasound system (Vantage 64LE, Verasonics) using 100 Hz PRF protocol (Fig. 4a, Table. 1, Pressure: 0.90 MPa, Pulse Repetition Frequency: 100 Hz, Pulse Duration: 0.5 ms, Duty Cycle: 5%, 30s ON 30s OFF for 5 minutes) per block every 90 minutes for a total of five blocks overnight following an ultradian sleep cycle schedule<sup>149,150</sup> .

flags.reason: Text gives 28 sleep-study subjects (16 healthy, 12 insomnia), 26 analysed after two were excluded for noise, 16 enrolled in the fMRI session, and healthy n = 15 in Table 2; the total exposed is not unambiguous.
Two consecutive nights (sham first, FUS second) plus a separate MRI-guided FUS fMRI session; 2 is the sleep-study count.
Table 1 gives 0.68MPa derated at 72.2 mm; text elsewhere says derated threshold >0.70 MPa. Table value recorded.
Table 1 column is headed Free-Field; whether 0.90 MPa is peak or peak-to-peak is not stated.
Each block is 30 s ON and 30 s OFF; 30 s taken as the uninterrupted train. Burst duty is given as 50%.
Authors state stimulation order was not counterbalanced (sham night first), single-blinded, no parallel control; recorded as false.
Transducer is described as custom-made; maker not named. Driver is a Verasonics Vantage 64LE HIFU.
